titulo: Monet time: French Renaissance painter's rarely seen 'Iris' set to break sale record
cuerpo: A total of 28 works from the Schlumberger collection are being sold at Sotheby's France. Valued at more than €40 million, they include four paintings by Claude Monet, pieces by Paul Cézanne and Gustave Moreau, and a sculpture by Camille Claudel.
